程序包 com.destroystokyo.paper.event.player

类 PlayerHandshakeEvent

java.lang.Object
org.bukkit.event.Event
com.destroystokyo.paper.event.player.PlayerHandshakeEvent
所有已实现的接口:
Cancellable
public class PlayerHandshakeEvent extends Event implements Cancellable
This event is fired during a player handshake. 此事件在玩家握手期间触发。

If there are no listeners listening to this event, the logic default to your server platform will be ran.

如果没有监听器监听此事件，将运行你的服务器平台默认的逻辑。

WARNING: TAMPERING WITH THIS EVENT CAN BE DANGEROUS

警告：篡改此事件可能带来危险

    • isCancelled

      public boolean isCancelled()
      Determines if this event is cancelled. 判断此事件是否已被取消。

      When this event is cancelled, custom handshake logic will not be processed.

      当此事件被取消时，自定义握手逻辑将不会被处理。
      指定者:
      isCancelled 在接口中 Cancellable
      返回:
      true if this event is cancelled, false otherwise 若此事件已被取消则为 true，否则为 false

    • getOriginalSocketAddressHostname

      public String getOriginalSocketAddressHostname()
      Gets the original socket address hostname. 获取原始套接字地址主机名。

      This does not include the port.

      其中不含端口号。

      In cases where this event is manually fired and the plugin wasn't updated yet, the default is "127.0.0.1".

      在此事件被手动触发且插件尚未更新的情况下，默认值为 "127.0.0.1"。
      返回:
      the original socket address hostname 原始套接字地址主机名

      Determines if authentication failed. 判断认证是否失败。

      When true, the client connecting will be disconnected with the fail message.
